meta.title: 2025 BEST HOI AN STREET FOOD Tour 🇻🇳 Eating Like A Local In Vietnam
meta.description:
Food we have NEVER heard of or tried BEFORE 🍜 on the Ultimate HOI AN STREET FOOD Tour in Vietnam

Join us as we dive into the vibrant streets of Hoi An, Vietnam, for the ultimate street food adventure! Guided by the legendary Sam, we explored the best local dishes, iconic markets, and hidden gems. This tour was an unforgettable culinary journey—packed with bold flavors, rich traditions, and insider tips to help you eat like a local. 🌟

📍 What We Ate in This Video:

1️⃣ Bún Chả Ta (Noodle Soup): A flavorful broth with fresh herbs and noodles. Hoi An Ancient Town 🍲
2️⃣ Cà Phê Trứng (Egg Coffee): Creamy, sweet, and the perfect pick-me-up. Hoi An Ancient Town ☕
3️⃣ Bánh Xèo (Rice Pancake): Crispy, savory, and stuffed with goodness. 📍 Hoi An Center Market 🥞
4️⃣ Xí Mà (Black Sesame Soup): A unique dessert that’s rich and nutty. 
5️⃣ Cơm Gà (Chicken Rice): A Hoi An classic that’s comforting and flavorful. Hoi An Ancient Town 🍗🍚
6️⃣ Bánh Mì: Vietnam’s most famous sandwich—crispy bread, fresh fillings, and bold flavors. 📍 115 Trần Cao Vân Street, Hoi An, Quảng Nam 🥖
7️⃣ Cao Lầu (Noodles): A regional specialty with thick noodles and pork. 📍 28 Thái Phiên, Hoi An Ancient Town 🍜
8️⃣ Bánh Bèo (Steamed Rice Cake): Soft, savory cakes topped with crispy goodness. 📍 Trần Cao Vân Street 🍘
9️⃣ Sinh Tố (Mixed Fruit Smoothie): Refreshing, fruity, and the perfect way to cool down. 📍 110 Nguyễn Trường Tộ, Hoi An Ancient Town 🥤

🛵 Tour Details:
We booked our tour through Hanoi Street Food Tour http://www.hanoistreetfoodtour.com/ and were guided by Sam, who made the experience unforgettable with his local knowledge and warm personality. Highly recommend this tour for anyone visiting Hoi An! 🙌

🎥 Why You’ll Love This Video:
We’re sharing:

Authentic Hoi An food experiences.
The best places to eat like a local.
Tips for finding hidden gems in the ancient town.
Whether you’re planning your trip or just love watching food tours, this video is your ultimate guide to Hoi An’s must-try dishes.
